en.name: Kiteroid
en.effect: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks directly (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no battle damage from that battle. During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks directly (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your Graveyard; you take no battle damage from that battle.

Durant le calcul des dommages, si un monstre de votre adversaire attaque directement (Effet Rapide) : vous pouvez bannir cette carte depuis votre Cimetière ; vous ne recevez aucun dommage de combat de ce combat.
